heroMockup: Industry package catalog (five industry tiles with Early access chips) opening into a package-contents window, then a real-estate buyer message thread next to an agent calendar where a Saturday-night portal inquiry becomes a held Monday showing. Ends on an ops panel of running agents and a 'stays with your team' list. No other unit uses the industry catalog + messaging thread + calendar slot combination; there is no approval-card hero here (that belongs to Brains).
sourceOfClaims: src/i18n/units/products.ts (hero, pains, offers, method, cases, faq, cta) and src/components/unit/ProductsSelector/copy.ts (industries, agents, connects, stays). Timelines used only as stated: Fit check 1 call, Adapt a few days, Pilot 2-4 weeks, Run by subscription; real estate 2-3 weeks to pilot. The Sat 23:40 inquiry and Monday showing come from the site's own illustrative use case (cases.items[0]) and are labeled 'Illustrative scenario' on screen. Listing address, hours, times and slot labels inside mock UIs are example UI states, never claims. No prices, no clients, no results.

textEn: A custom AI build is too much, for now.
Generic tools don't know your industry.
textEs: Un desarrollo a medida es demasiado por ahora.
Y las herramientas genéricas no conocen tu industria.

textEn: Ready-made agents, set up on your data.
textEs: Agentes listos, configurados con tus datos.

textEn: Agents already designed for your sector.
textEs: 01  Elige el paquete de tu industria
Agentes ya diseñados para tu sector.

Window 'real-estate / settings' (x 280 to 1640, y 280 to 860) laid out as a settings form with five labeled rows on a hairline grid. Values fill in one after another by typeText from 24.8 s, 0.7 s apart: Services 'Sales, Rentals' (ES 'Venta, Alquiler'); Areas 'North, Center, Coast' (ES 'Norte, Centro, Costa'); Tone 'Warm, short, no jargon' (ES 'Cercano, breve, sin tecnicismos'); Hours 'Replies 24/7, showings Mon to Sat' (ES 'Responde 24/7, visitas de lunes a sábado'); Escalation 'Pricing questions go to the listing agent' (ES 'Preguntas de precio van al asesor'). textEn: Your services, tone, hours and escalation rules.

scenes.visual: Step header '03' + time chip '2-4 weeks' (ES '2-4 semanas'); small mono tag 'Illustrative scenario' (ES 'Escenario ilustrativo') under the header. (ES 'Hola, ¿sigue disponible la casa de 3 dormitorios cerca del colegio?'); assistant at 34.0 s, cube icon, 'Yes, it is. I'm the brokerage's assistant. Which area works for you, and when do you plan to move?' (ES 'Sí, sigue disponible. Soy el asistente de la inmobiliaria. ¿Qué zona te sirve y cuándo piensas mudarte?'); buyer at 35.8 s 'This area. (ES '¿Te sirve una visita el lunes 9:30 o el martes 18:00?'); buyer at 38.6 s 'Monday works.' (ES 'El lunes me sirve.'). Right column 'Recent' with three log rows fading up from 46.6 s: 'Pricing question → handed to listing agent' (ES 'Pregunta de precio → derivada al asesor'), 'Monitoring check · OK' (ES 'Revisión de monitoreo · OK'), 'Product update installed' (ES 'Actualización del producto instalada'). The first log row is highlighted at 47.6 s. Caption line 2 at 48.2 s. Hold to 51.4 s, fade out.

Two flat cards on a centered grid (y 300 to 760). LEFT card (x 120 to 920), eyebrow 'Always stays with your team' (ES 'Siempre queda en manos de tu equipo'): three rows with a person icon, fading up from 52.4 s: 'Pricing advice and negotiation', 'The showings themselves', 'Final say on every listing' (ES 'Asesoría de precio y negociación', 'Las visitas en sí', 'La última palabra en cada ficha'). RIGHT card (x 1000 to 1800): a small three-step steps component 'Package → Your setup → Custom brain' (ES 'Paquete → Tu configuración → Brain a medida') that advances with .go at 54.6 s and 55.4 s, last node in flame. textEn: People keep the calls that matter.
Outgrow it? It extends, no restart.
textEs: Las decisiones importantes siguen siendo tuyas.
¿Te queda chico? Crece sin empezar de cero.
